name: Colin Cantwell
description: Imperial attack craft or the Sith fighter were starfighters that were launched out of the various Imperial vessels, which would then proceed to attack the planets nearby. They had a sleek and flat triangular design with a black cockpit and red linings near the wings and tailfins, although some versions had a prism-based cockpit window.

data.name: Colin Cantwell
data.quote: PS - those fighters in the concept illustration were the original imperial attack ships. I didn't create the #TIE until much later. See the other concepts at www.cantwellcollection.com
